newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Pinto jumps on results optimism.
newsitem.headline: Banco Pinto jumps on results optimism.

text.p: Shares in Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) surged 3.76 percent on Thursday to 1,075 escudos on optimism about the bank's nine month results which should be released shortly, traders said.
"There is talk of good growth in commission income," said one trader.

But another trader noted that Banco Totta & Acores had also risen strongly ahead of its results, published on Wednesday night, but that it was losing nearly one percent on Thursday. Banco Totta announced a 5.7 percent rise in profit to 16.74 billion escudos.
Banco Pinto reported a non-consolidated profit of 8.14 billion escudos in the first nine months of 1995.
